questions.q: What is the capital of Belarus?
questions.why: It was almost fully destroyed in the Second World War.

questions.q: In which year did Belarus become independent?
questions.why: It declared independence on 25 August.

questions.q: Who has been President of Belarus since 1994?
questions.why: He is called 'Europe's last dictator'.

questions.q: Which fortress resisted German attack for weeks in 1941?
questions.why: It is a war memorial.

questions.q: Which 1986 nuclear disaster affected much of Belarus?
questions.why: About 70% of the fallout landed on Belarus.

questions.q: Which agreement signed in Belarus in 1991 ended the Soviet Union?
questions.why: It was signed in a forest lodge.

questions.q: Which state did Belarus belong to with Lithuania in the Middle Ages?
questions.why: Old Belarusian was its official language.

questions.q: Which opposition leader ran for President in 2020?
questions.why: She left for Lithuania after the vote.

questions.q: Which Belarusian author won the 2015 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.why: She wrote 'The Unwomanly Face of War'.

questions.q: Which printer published the first Belarusian books in 1517?
questions.why: He worked in Prague.

questions.q: Which ancient city was the first capital of a Belarusian principality?
questions.why: It is first mentioned in 862.

questions.q: Which painter born in Vitebsk is famous for dreamy village scenes?
questions.why: His house is a museum.

questions.q: Which leader of the 1863 uprising is a Belarusian national hero?
questions.why: He published a revolutionary newspaper.

questions.q: Which military leader born near Brest fought in the American Revolution?
questions.why: He also led a Polish uprising in 1794.

questions.q: Which village was destroyed with its people by Nazi forces in 1943?
questions.why: Its memorial has bells that ring every 30 seconds.

questions.q: What is Belarus's currency?
questions.why: It was redenominated in 2016.

questions.q: Which ancient forest on the Polish border is home to European bison?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which potato pancakes are the national dish?
questions.why: Belarusians eat a lot of potatoes.

questions.q: Which castle with red-brick towers is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It was built in the 1500s.

questions.q: Which large region of marshes lies in southern Belarus?
questions.why: It is one of Europe's largest wetlands.

questions.q: Which sport is Lukashenko famous for playing?
questions.why: Belarus hosted the 2014 Ice Hockey World Championship.

questions.q: How many lakes is Belarus said to have?
questions.why: It is called 'the land of blue lakes'.

questions.q: Which palace and castle complex was home to the Radziwiłł family?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which art festival in Vitebsk features Slavic music?
questions.why: It began in 1992.

questions.q: Which Belarusian tennis player has been world number one and won the Australian Open?
questions.why: She won it in 2023 and 2024.

questions.q: Which tennis player from Minsk won the Australian Open in 2012 and 2013?
questions.why: She was world number one in 2012.

questions.q: What is Belarus's largest lake?
questions.why: It is a popular resort.

questions.q: Which gymnast from Minsk won four golds at the 1972 Olympics?
questions.why: She was famous for her backflip on the beam.

questions.q: Which Belarusian poet wrote 'And Who Goes There?'
questions.why: It became an unofficial anthem.

questions.q: Which summer festival on the shortest night involves bonfires and wreaths?
questions.why: People search for a magical fern flower.
